title: White Bread Plait
description: A simple three-ingredient loaf of strong white flour, fast-action yeast and water, plaited and baked to golden perfection.
steps: Sift the flour into a bowl, add the yeast, stir. Add half the water and mix with your hands, then add the rest gradually until the dough is tacky.
Knead on an oiled surface for 5–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place in a greased bowl, cover with oiled cling film and leave in a warm place for up to 3 hours until doubled in size.
Knock the air out, divide into three equal pieces and roll each into a 40cm sausage. Plait the three strands, securing both ends.
Place on a lined baking sheet, cover and prove for another hour until springy.
Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan. Place a tray of boiling water on the lower shelf for steam.
Bake for 40 minutes until golden and hollow-sounding when tapped. Cool on a wire rack.
notes: Serves 12–14. The steam from the water tray helps crisp the crust.
